name: test-stack
description: Test stack skills for .NET: tests with MSTest 4, FluentAssertions 7.2.2 or AwesomeAssertions 9, NSubstitute, fakes, FakeTimeProvider, WebApplicationFactory, and Testcontainers, and the step-by-step move from FluentAssertions to AwesomeAssertions. Each skill gives version-specific rules, a check step with a tool, and one report format. Output in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).
